verdict.rationale: LangSmith can be driven programmatically without the UI. It offers Python, TypeScript, Go and Java SDKs, API access to traces, and automation via rules, webhooks and online evaluations. Dataset-based experiments that "catch regressions" are a natural fit for CI gating, but the evidence never documents CI use explicitly. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration docs (e.g. pipeline examples or pass/fail gating), a documented headless CLI, a published OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404), and hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
